description: Book and change sessions; assign tutors; enroll new families and record consent; send reminders; answer parent calls and messages
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every session depends on the day's schedule; about 60 sessions a day and about $3,700 of billing per operating day; schedule changes arrive daily, so more than half a day of lost changes causes no-shows and double bookings
manual_workaround: Weekly printed schedule (from 2026-09; R-020); front desk phone; parents told by text from the suite
dependent_third_parties: Scheduling and billing platform vendor; productivity suite vendor; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Enrollment and Billing Coordinator; Center Director; front desk

business_process: In-person tutoring at the learning center
description: One-to-one and small-group sessions in the 6 tutoring rooms; tutors use the platform for lesson materials, practice exercises, and session notes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 180 in-person sessions a week; a lost operating day is about $2,200 of in-person billing and make-up sessions; session notes are written the same day
manual_workaround: Printed lesson packets and paper session notes entered into the platform when restored; tutors bring their own lesson plans
dependent_third_parties: Tutoring platform vendor; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: 3 Lead Tutors; contractor tutors; learning center

description: Live sessions in the platform's online classroom, mostly taught by contractor tutors from home
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 120 online sessions a week; online families have no in-person alternative the same day; recordings and notes are created during the session
manual_workaround: Move the session to a suite video meeting with recording off (staff host only, no child accounts); reschedule within the week
dependent_third_parties: Tutoring platform vendor; productivity suite vendor

description: Tutoring at 2 elementary schools on Tuesday and Thursday for about 90 students; attendance and progress reported to the district
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The contract requires sessions to be delivered or made up and attendance to be reported weekly; the next program day is at most 2 days away; losing the contract is about $180,000 a year
manual_workaround: Paper attendance sheets and printed lesson packets; report attendance to the district by email from a clean device
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Tutoring; Lead Tutors; contractor tutors; 2 school sites

description: Diagnostic assessments at intake; monthly progress reports to parents; quarterly progress reports to the district
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reports are monthly and quarterly, so a few days' delay is tolerable; assessment results entered in the platform must not be lost
manual_workaround: Paper assessments scored by hand and entered later; delay reports by up to a week with notice

description: Intake forms; evaluation reports and IEP or 504 plan excerpts provided by parents; consent records; parent requests to review or delete information
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tutors need accommodation details before a new student's first session; parent requests must be answered promptly; records restored from the nightly suite backup
manual_workaround: Ask parents to re-send documents; tutors use the platform's short accommodation note
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; backup service (MSP subcontractor); MSP

description: Monthly autopay invoices on the 1st; card payments through the integrated processor; district invoices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Billing runs monthly, so a few days' delay only defers cash; about $77,000 is billed each month; the cash reserve covers about 45 days of expenses
manual_workaround: Re-run the billing batch when restored; email invoices from a clean device; district invoices sent monthly
dependent_third_parties: Scheduling and billing platform vendor; payment processor (through the platform)

description: Staff and contractor onboarding and offboarding; contractor agreements; HR files; payroll and contractor payments through an outside payroll service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll and contractor payments run every two weeks through the payroll service; HR files are needed rarely
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll service; restore HR files from backup
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; productivity suite vendor; MSP
